title: Backhaul machine config
description: Per-machine, gitignored config (config.local.json) telling Backhaul where content roots live on this machine and which optional modules are enabled. See migration/MIGRATION_PLAN.md §6.

version.description: This config file's schema version — must exactly match foundation/config.py's CONFIG_SCHEMA_VERSION for this checkout (currently "0.1.0"), or load_config() refuses to load it. Bumped only on a breaking config shape change (required key added/renamed/removed), not on every package release — adding a new optional key like content_roots.roadmap does not require bumping this.

project_name.description: Display name shown in every piece of Backhaul content's normalized header (e.g. "mcRepos", "LunaFlow_A"). Optional — falls back to content_roots.tickets's grandparent folder name when omitted.

content_roots.description: Paths to this machine's actual ticket/wiki content, outside the repo. Every value must be an absolute path on whatever machine is actually running the CLI right now — load_config() refuses to load a config containing a path that isn't absolute on the current OS (e.g. a Windows "C:\\..." path loaded inside a Linux sandbox parses as one opaque relative segment, not an error, and every write would silently land relative to cwd instead of touching real content — refusing to load is the safety net for that). A session running somewhere other than the machine this config was written for (e.g. a launched role's Cowork sandbox) can export the BACKHAUL_LOCAL_ROOT environment variable to re-root every value here onto wherever the project actually lives on that process's own filesystem before this check runs — see foundation/config.py and the README's "BACKHAUL_LOCAL_ROOT" section. Deliberately an env var, not a field here, since the correct value changes every session.

roadmap.description: Optional — only needed if "roadmap" is in enabled_modules. One folder per project; individual graphs are scoped within it by client UID prefix (RM_<uid>_NNN.md), not by subfolder.

roles.description: Optional — only needed if "roles" is in enabled_modules. One folder per project holding that project's agent-role pages (see modules/roles).

enabled_modules.description: Optional module ids to enable (e.g. "docx", "shortcuts", "handlers.editmd", "handlers.openfolder"). BHT/BHW are always on and not listed here.

client_folders.description: Per-client UID -> project folder path (e.g. "UW": "C:\\Projects\\University of Washington"), used by the ticket header's Folder link (opened via the openfolder: protocol handler). A client UID with no entry here falls back to content_roots.tickets's parent directory.

repo_url.description: Optional — this Backhaul checkout's own git remote (e.g. "https://github.com/amkeyte/Backhaul"). When set, modules/roles' Launch links include a `pip install git+<repo_url>...` line so a freshly launched role session (a bare sandbox with only the project folder attached, not Backhaul's own source) can install the bht/bhw/bhrm/bhrole CLI for itself before doing anything else. Omit to leave that line out of Launch links entirely.

host_root.description: Optional — this project's real root path on the machine a human will actually open links on (e.g. "C:\\_local\\mcRepos"), independent of wherever content_roots currently resolves at runtime. Set this when the CLI might run somewhere other than that real machine (e.g. a Cowork sandbox mounting the project under a different path) so editmd:/openfolder: Edit and Folder links, and role Launch links' project-folder line, still point at the real path instead of baking in wherever the CLI happened to execute. Omit to keep today's default: links are built straight from content_roots as printed.
